description: The Message Bar visual adds a clear context layer to Power BI reports by displaying rule-based messages directly on the canvas. It helps users understand what the numbers mean without relying on extra pages, notes, or explanations. You can configure up to eight independent rules. Each rule compares a KPI against a target or condition and, when triggered, displays a message bar with a defined severity level such as Info, Success, Caution, Critical, or No Message. When multiple rules apply, messages stack automatically to provide a concise, prioritised summary of what matters right now. Key features: Up to 8 configurable rules per visual KPI vs target or condition evaluation Severity levels: Info, Success, Caution, Critical, or No Message Custom message text per rule Optional detailed explanation text Stacked messages with remaining count indicator User-dismissible messages Typical use cases: Explaining KPI performance directly on report pages Highlighting risks, exceptions, or threshold breaches Adding business context, caveats, or guidance without extra pages Surfacing what needs attention right now A downloadable sample PBIX is available via the “Download sample” option, providing a fully functional example and a hints and tips page to help users get started quickly. The Message Bar visual is ideal for adding commentary, caveats, alerts, and guidance directly into reports,…
